headline: Low interaction risk overall; no shared channel or write surface is documented, but A’s allowlisted egress and B’s audio-file ingestion create limited indirect leakage and workflow-confusion paths.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented between nuwa-skill and whisper. A has only allowlisted network egress, while B has no clipboard, MCP, stdin/stdout, or filesystem read/write surfaces exposed, so a prompt-injection bridge is not evidenced.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is added between the agents, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared workspace.
Do not route raw model outputs from A into B as instructions.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: A can send data over allowlisted egress, but B is documented as network-closed and only handling audio/speech files. With no shared workspace or secrets listed, leakage is limited and not shown in default operation, though A could still exfiltrate any content it is given.
conditions: IF A is given sensitive text and its allowlist permits an external endpoint, that content can leave the local environment.
IF B is fed sensitive audio files, those contents remain local unless another bridge is added.
mitigations: Restrict A’s allowlist to known internal endpoints.
Avoid placing secrets in any inputs passed to A.
Store B’s audio inputs in a separate directory.
Review outbound destinations before running A.
requires-engineering: add DLP or content filtering on A’s egress.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write-capable surfaces are documented. A’s profile exposes only allowlisted network egress, while B explicitly cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, execute shells, or spawn subprocesses, so a direct capability conflict is not supported.
conditions: IF A is later granted filesystem, git, or database write access on the same resource as another agent, conflict risk would emerge.
mitigations: Do not grant A additional write scopes without coordination.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared mutable resources are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: A and B do not show a documented pipeline where B treats A’s output as authoritative. B is a speech/audio model with no action-taking authority, so cascading error is limited to manual misuse rather than default automation.
conditions: IF an operator feeds A’s generated text into B as ground truth, B may propagate errors in transcription or summarization.
IF B is wrapped in a downstream automation layer, its outputs could be acted on without verification.
mitigations: Require human review of A’s outputs before reuse.
Do not chain A’s text directly into B without validation.
requires-engineering: add verification checks between agents.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented for this pair. A is open-source with no touched data classes listed, and B only lists audio/speech data classes, so there is no evidenced compliance breach pathway to score.
conditions: IF either agent is later used on regulated data with a mismatched hosting or retention policy, compliance risk would need reassessment.
mitigations: Document the data classes before deployment.
Keep regulated data out of both agents until policies are confirmed.
requires-engineering: map residency and retention controls if regulated data is introduced.
